ModMetaData.name: Jawa Faction Slate
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
Takes every faction except the campaign's own off the Configure Factions page, so a generated world contains exactly the intended slate.
🔴 THIS MOD MUST LOAD LAST, OR IT SILENTLY DOES HALF ITS JOB. Every operation is a PatchOperationConditional testing that the FactionDef exists, with no <nomatch> - which is deliberate, because a def belonging to a dropped mod would otherwise throw a red error every load. The cost of that choice is that a faction whose mod has NOT LOADED YET is also a silent no-op. Measured 2026-08-20 after a RimSort re-sort put this mod at 184 of 577: 24 of the 48 factions it patches were defined by mods loading after it, so half the slate would have appeared on the Configure Factions page anyway - and a world generates ONCE.
✅ FIXED 2026-08-29, JAWA_FACTION_SLATE_LOAD_ORDER_1: `forceLoadAfter` below names the packageId of every mod that owns one of the 48 patched FactionDefs, built from the live def dump's per-def `packageId` attribution (2026-08-29T20-07-29Z capture) — not guessed. Core/DLC packageIds (ludeon.rimworld*) are omitted: the engine loads Core and the official expansions before any Steam Workshop or local mod unconditionally, so they can never be the late arrival. Three targeted defNames — CAEvilSacrilegHunters, CAFriendlyMechanoid, guy762_KotORFaction_Civilians — resolve against nothing under the CURRENT mod versions (removed from Caravan Adventures by its 1.6 folder; guy762 KotOR Civilians ships under an AdditionalMods/_FactionsBase folder its own LoadFolders.xml never references for v1.6) and are excluded — not load-order bugs, permanently-unmatched PatchOperationConditional targets, harmless by this mod's own no-<nomatch> design. UPDATE 2026-09-04, XML_PATCH_VALIDATION_SWEEP_1: re-verified against each mod's current installed XML — CAEvilSacrilegHunters and CAFriendlyMechanoid are gone from Caravan Adventures for good (not a version fluke) and their now-permanently-dead Operation blocks were removed from OnlyOurFactions.xml; guy762_KotORFaction_Civilians is still a real defName, just in a mod (guy762.KotORFactions) that is not currently active, so its block stays as a correct guarded no-op.
